vocabulary.definition: the intent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnical, racial or religious group
vocabulary.example: The UN report accused Israel of committing genocide against Palestinians in Gaza.

vocabulary.definition: a group of people saying the same thing; a collective opinion or voice
vocabulary.example: There is a rising chorus of voices demanding action on climate change.

vocabulary.definition: to blame for something; being held accountable for actions
vocabulary.example: The investigation held the government responsible for the mistake.

vocabulary.definition: a purpose or plan; the state of having one's mind set on something
vocabulary.example: The UN report suggested evidence of genocidal intent in the actions of Israeli forces.

vocabulary.definition: biased or one-sided; presenting information in a way that favors a particular side
vocabulary.example: The former Israeli PM criticized the UN report as being sloppy and slanted.

vocabulary.definition: careless or messy; not done with care or precision
vocabulary.example: The candidate's sloppy appearance during the interview made a bad impression.
